ValidationRule.description: This rule triggers if Status is equal to ‘Closed’ and Closure Reason is left blank .
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND (NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case" , ISPICKVAL(Status , "Closed") , ISPICKVAL( IME_SC_Closure_Reason__c , "") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Closure reason is required while closing the case.
